notes: Item 19 is present with three parts: Part I covers average gross revenue by tenure cohort for US unaffiliated and DBA franchisees (12 months ending Dec 31, 2024); Part II covers franchisees by gross revenue range; Part III covers system-wide revenue and growth for 2022-2024. The table header on page 48 reads 'For the Twelve Months Ending December 31, 2023' but all contextual references indicate this is 2024 data (consistent with the rest of Item 19 and the total revenue table on the same page labeled 'Total 2024 Gross Revenue'). This appears to be a drafting error in the document. An OCR artifact was noted: '$359.145' in the per-subterritory high for the 72+ months cohort was interpreted as $359,145. The document intro references 147 Franchised Businesses (105 unaffiliated + 42 DBA). Per-subterritory metrics are included as separate records. System-wide revenue totals are recorded as total_revenue with null avg/median since only aggregate totals are given.
